en.quote: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to Me, to walk in My law, which I have set before you, To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;
en.riddle: If ye will not hearken to Me, to walk in My law
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה אִם-לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ, אֵלַי, לָלֶכֶת בְּתוֹרָתִי אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶֽם לִשְׁמֹעַ עַל-דִּבְרֵי עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִאִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁלֵחַ אֲלֵיכֶם וְהַשְׁכֵּם וְשָׁלֹחַ וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
